# XML

Indent or minify XML, keeping comments and CDATA.

Category: Formatters · ID: `xml-format` · Search terms: xml, pretty, minify, beautify, svg, html

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui xml-format [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--indent` | 0–8 | `2` | Indent. Spaces per level; 0 = minify |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/xml-format`), so they are what the tool prints.

### catalog-indent2

Input:

```text
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [ <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe"> ]>
<!-- Example catalog -->
<catalog xmlns:x="urn:x"><book id="b1" lang='en'><title>One Hundred Years</title><author>&author;</author>
<price currency="USD">45</price><notes><![CDATA[<b>unescaped</b> & ready]]></notes><x:empty/><tags></tags>
</book><?proc instruction?><book id="b2"><title>Another &amp; more</title></book></catalog>
```

Output:

```text
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [ <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe"> ]>
<!-- Example catalog -->
<catalog xmlns:x="urn:x">
  <book id="b1" lang='en'>
    <title>One Hundred Years</title>
    <author>&author;</author>
    <price currency="USD">45</price>
    <notes><![CDATA[<b>unescaped</b> & ready]]></notes>
    <x:empty/>
    <tags></tags>
  </book>
  <?proc instruction?>
  <book id="b2">
    <title>Another &amp; more</title>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

### catalog-minify

Input:

```text
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [ <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe"> ]>
<!-- Example catalog -->
<catalog xmlns:x="urn:x"><book id="b1" lang='en'><title>One Hundred Years</title><author>&author;</author>
<price currency="USD">45</price><notes><![CDATA[<b>unescaped</b> & ready]]></notes><x:empty/><tags></tags>
</book><?proc instruction?><book id="b2"><title>Another &amp; more</title></book></catalog>
```

Output:

```text
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE catalog [ <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe"> ]><!-- Example catalog --><catalog xmlns:x="urn:x"><book id="b1" lang='en'><title>One Hundred Years</title><author>&author;</author><price currency="USD">45</price><notes><![CDATA[<b>unescaped</b> & ready]]></notes><x:empty/><tags></tags></book><?proc instruction?><book id="b2"><title>Another &amp; more</title></book></catalog>
```
